_generation_contract.spec_availability: The source references multihop_scenario_spec_v2.md but did not supply it. This file implements the attached prompt plus the explicit additive assumptions below; conformance to an unseen external schema is not claimed.
_generation_contract.synthetic_scope: All issuers, holdings, financial disclosures, market observations, policies, historical samples, record IDs and normalized score mappings are invented. No customer data, real market quote or measured customer metric is represented.

scoring.rule: Unweighted squared Euclidean distance to action-profile interval midpoints; select the unique minimum.
scoring.ties: No ties are accepted in surface, final or subset labels during validation.
scoring.relation_to_production: A transparent synthetic oracle only. It does not claim to reproduce the live Trading scorer, learned Voronoi geometry, its factor dimension, DK weights, overrides or model state.

_generation_contract.normalization: factor_new_value is a deliberately planted normalized fixture score supported directionally by its evidence. The raw-to-score map has not been fitted or calibrated from market data.
_generation_contract.schema_extensions: All requested scenario fields are retained. Additional top-level contract and validation fields, alert timestamps, branch access/graph/provenance fields, hop diagnostics, and evaluation_metadata make assumptions and access rules explicit. A strict external parser may need an adapter.
repairs_to_prompt: Action ranges were converted to interval midpoint centroids with equal weights, so wrong-surface and right-final labels can be tested.
Template 1 adds separately supported fundamental-strength and liquidity-risk hops. Thesis reversal plus concentration alone did not reliably produce reject under the declared metric.
Template 4 adds portfolio_concentration through aggregate illiquid-sleeve exposure. It now satisfies the required two distinct factor shifts and supplies arithmetically consistent reduced sizing.
Template 6 reject variants add independently supported correlation and liquidity evidence; macro rotation or flows alone do not justify an issuer-fundamental downgrade or guarantee a reject label.
Earnings/volatility and sector-flow observations do not directly change fundamental_strength. Separate already-public company disclosures support those factor changes.
Historical RSI reversions are planted pre-alert observations and are never asserted to predict the current outcome with certainty.
Block D retains rho=0.50, hops and one truth label per action, but is a routing-noise check. The unsupported claim that VLD must achieve 0.200 action accuracy has been removed.

read_protocol.catalog_visibility: available_branches and the full graph are evaluator-owned catalogs, not free agent observations.
initial_agent_view: opaque IDs and read costs of evaluation_metadata.initial_frontier candidates
planted noisy routing scores for that frontier
read_protocol.read_response: After charging read_cost, reveal only the selected evidence_found, factor_enriched, factor_new_value, narration, record_id, known_at and its local graph_path. A current record also returns its lookup token and unlocks the next two-candidate frontier; a superseded or mismatched record does not.
read_protocol.access_enforcement: A branch is readable once, only after all access.requires_completed_branches were read and its required lookup token was returned. Access checks use observed tokens, not free access to evaluator labels. Reject unauthorized or repeated reads without revealing evidence. Charge before releasing a valid read response.
read_protocol.factor_update: Apply each returned factor_new_value only to factor_enriched, starting from surface_factors. Distractors preserve the initial value for that factor. Catalog order never sets execution order.
read_protocol.budget: Every valid branch read costs 1; budget equals the number of required hops. Each stage has one current record and one non-governing distractor. Any wasted read makes the full gold path unaffordable.
read_protocol.routing_scores: At each newly eligible binary frontier, an evaluator privately samples U uniformly in [0,1). If U < rho_planted, give the useful candidate score 0.8 and its distractor 0.2; otherwise reverse them. Shuffle candidate display order independently and record the seed and draws. These are artificial routing cues supplied by an oracle for a positive control, not scores learned by a production policy.
read_protocol.rho_semantics: rho_planted is the intended per-frontier probability that the useful branch ranks first, conditional on reaching that frontier. It is not action accuracy, a correlation coefficient, calibrated confidence or an observed effect size. This JSON does not contain a completed stochastic routing experiment.
read_protocol.independence_assumption: Independent frontier score draws are a harness assumption. For a policy always choosing the higher score and a zero-slack budget, complete-path probability is rho_planted raised to required hop count; final action accuracy is not inferred from that probability.
read_protocol.sampling: Shuffle scenario presentation and branch display order; hide template and sequential IDs. Use separate seeds for route-score draws and candidate order. Repeated seeds are repeated routing trials, not new independent market situations.
read_protocol.acquisition_type: Known-record retrieval followed by observation-keyed version/scope joins. These are prerequisite/dependent acquisition positive controls. A hop means a charged investigation read, consistent with the supplied example; each primary evidence record is one edge from the trade signal. Access dependencies are not additional economic graph edges. The file does not by itself isolate folded versus entangled geometry or establish native multi-edge graph-traversal benefits.
read_protocol.breadth_comparison: With all evidence supplied for free, a breadth reader can resolve these fixtures. Any claimed advantage must come from measured performance under an equal charged access budget, not from an unrestricted-versus-restricted information comparison.

_generation_contract.ground_truth_semantics: Ground truth is the declared nearest-centroid decision after the planted valid enrichments. Leave-one-hop-out and every-proper-subset necessity are mathematical properties of this oracle, not proof that every read is logically required by a real portfolio mandate.

rho50_and_baselines.block_D: Five instances, one per action, all with evidence hops and rho 0.50. Retained as binary-routing sensitivity checks, not a validated null of action information.
rho50_and_baselines.interpretation: Uniform random five-action guesses have expected accuracy 0.2. Uninformative binary routing scores alone do not make evidence or final actions uninformative. Empirical action accuracy must be measured. Five check cases do not support a precise calibration claim.
rho50_and_baselines.recommended_separate_null: For a true action-information null, create a separate label-blinded or permuted-label diagnostic independent of every policy-visible observation, with uniform held-out actions and sufficient trials; label it as an artificial null and do not mix it into these evidence-grounded ground truths.

limitations: The requested A/B templates are strongly directional: their initial action is execute. Scenario family, order and description can leak labels unless hidden; hold out whole families for any learning evaluation.
The moderate label describes lower planted routing reliability only. Geometry still requires at least two large factor changes; it is not an empirical estimate of moderate case difficulty.
Rho 0.30 is an anti-informative top-rank cue under this binary definition. A policy told rho is below 0.50 can improve routing by inverting the cue, so rho is evaluator-only.
Different hop counts change complete-path probability and read cost. Stratify outcomes by hop count and rho and compare identical geometry under multiple rho draws when studying routing reliability.
The fixed midpoint metric can select an action even if some unchanged factors lie outside that action's profile intervals; profiles are centroid definitions, not six simultaneous hard constraints.
Capacity arithmetic is internally consistent but simplistically assumes constant executable daily capacity; the underlying measurements and budgets remain invented.
No real-world VLD value, deployment m, routing rho, acquisition taxonomy prevalence, latency, production compatibility or economic P&L uplift has been measured.
